design: Before inspecting any model outputs, fix two formatting sensitivities for every human or practical judgment. Recompute tool grounding independently from the saved tool arguments and observations. Strict requires the exact bare lowercase-insensitive visible word true, false or uncertain. The final-sentence score accepts a short conclusion with a single unique verdict word or registered synonym, excluding explicit negation of that word. Neither changes the original scorer or decision. Publish every eligible interpretation disagreement and its full visible text.
